separate_oracles.causal_limit: Candidate changes proposal schema and production atomic system instructions, and may change generated wording/strategy. Host counterfactual controls isolate containment; full-chain outcomes alone do not isolate which instruction or generated text caused improvement.
separate_oracles.handoff_consistency: Accepted downstream action must match that model proposal own exact family/target/objective, or return explicit no-input replan. Injected mismatch controls must be rejected independently of decoder constraints.
separate_oracles.no_effect_credit: No input, effect, acquired content, artifact, task progress or completion credit from schema/binding consistency.
separate_oracles.proposal_source_validity: Immediate family/target must be among actual observed source alternatives; this does not verify semantic quality.
separate_oracles.semantic_alignment: Independent review of whether chosen operation advances original task. Do not pass an arbitrary but structurally consistent wrong window or breadcrumb.

steps: Baseline replays exact archived proposal and action requests, preserving historical chaining. If re-running the proposal, construct downstream from its actual new output and label this a new chain rather than replaying old downstream output.
Candidate derives proposal view/schema with actual subgoal_context(compact,atomic_anchor=True); do not inject the manually reconstructed host-case anchor or any expected target into model inputs.

Bind actual returned candidate proposal with bind_subgoal(...atomic_anchor=True); submit its actual resulting compact/action schema to the same loaded model, then expand actual response without desktop input.

Pin model weights, native think:false, temperature0,num_predict8192,text-only settings, scope/current observation and host source. Baseline system messages remain byte-identical. Candidate system/schema changes must be exactly the actual frozen production atomic route (SUBGOAL_SYSTEM+ATOMIC_SUBGOAL_SYSTEM_SUFFIX and SYSTEM+ATOMIC_SUBGOAL_HANDOFF plus its source-bound objective instructions), with code hashes and exact wire deltas retained; no evaluator-written hints. Record every failure, model/GPU/context identity and all unrun cells.

objective: Test exact source-bound immediate operation family/observed target consistency across proposal/action boundaries, separate from semantic task success.

proposed_interface.target_omission: Only source families genuinely lacking observed selectors. All four frozen sources here have observed targets.
